summary: Gold Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its press release dated November 4, 2026, reporting record third-quarter and nine-month 2026 results. Revenue reached $10.2 million (up ~147% year over year), Total Revenue, Land Agreement Proceeds and Interest $11.5 million, Adjusted EBITDA $9.0 million, net income $3.8 million, and GEOs 2,689 (up ~103%); guidance of 7,500-9,300 GEOs is reaffirmed with 76% of the midpoint achieved. The quarter included $0.8 million of small Nevada royalty acquisitions. No transaction, board recommendation, or special-situation terms were disclosed; this is a routine earnings report and warrants no event-driven positioning.
